app.title: 3D planter configurator
app.noWebglBody: You can still configure the machine, see the price, calculate field performance and request a quote. To see the 3D view, try an up-to-date Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
app.contextLost: The 3D viewer restarted to free up memory.
app.error: Something went wrong in the viewer. Reload the page to continue.

model.name: Model
model.hint: Choose the model for the working width you need.

rows.name: Rows
rows.hint: Number of rows and row spacing.

transport.name: Transport
transport.hint: How it travels on the road.

rowUnit.name: Row unit
rowUnit.hint: Everything that works in the furrow.

sp10c.name: SP 10C
sp10c.desc: For smaller fields and contractors on the move.

sp16m.name: SP 16M
sp16m.desc: Our best seller: the right balance of capacity and tractor size.

fold.name: Wing fold
fold.desc: Hydraulic cylinders fold the wings up.

longitudinal.name: Endways transport
longitudinal.desc: The planter turns 90° on its transport wheels and is towed end-first. Narrow and safe on the road.

flotation.name: High flotation
flotation.desc: Wide tires: less compaction and better traction in wet fields.

individual.name: Individual hoppers
individual.desc: One hopper per row: simple and rugged.

central.name: Central air-delivery hopper
central.desc: One large tank with air delivery to every row. Faster refills.

std.name: Standard
std.desc: 60 L per row or 1,800 L central.

large.name: Large
large.desc: 80 L per row or 2,600 L central. More acres between refills.

inline.name: In-furrow fertilizer
inline.desc: Fertilizer is placed in the seed furrow, right behind the coulter.

side.name: Side-band fertilizer
side.desc: A separate disc places fertilizer 5 cm (2 in) from the seed, so it won't burn it.

std.name: 1,800 L
std.desc: Central tank with lid, ladder and walkway.

large.name: 2,800 L
large.desc: Fewer refill stops in large fields.

turbo.name: Turbo
turbo.desc: Cuts residue with minimal soil disturbance. Ideal for no-till.

wavy.name: Wavy
wavy.desc: Tills a wider strip. Helps in cold soils or heavy residue.

castiron.name: Cast iron
castiron.desc: Extra weight to close the furrow in heavy soils.

spiked.name: Spiked
spiked.desc: Crumble the sidewall and remove air pockets.

on.name: With firmer
on.desc: Presses seed into the bottom of the furrow for more even emergence.

pneumatic.name: Pneumatic (airbags)
pneumatic.desc: Even pressure across the whole width, adjustable from the cab.

chain.name: Mechanical, chain drive
chain.desc: Simple, proven and easy to repair in the field.

pneumatic.name: Vacuum meter
pneumatic.desc: Vacuum seed discs: very accurate singulation.

electric.name: Electric drive, one motor per row
electric.desc: Each row has its own motor: enables row-by-row shutoff and variable rate.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.desc: Touchscreen with maps, shutoffs and field records.

on.name: Yes
on.desc: Shuts off each row when it enters an already planted headland: less overlap, less seed wasted.

on.name: Ready
on.desc: Changes population by management zone, from a prescription map.

on.name: Ready
on.desc: Controlled from the tractor's compatible terminal.

on.name: Ready
on.desc: Ready for autosteer: parallel passes with no overlaps.

rules.compactFold: The compact model travels with its wings folded.
rules.longitudinalAboveWidth: Above 10.5 m (34 ft) working width, endways transport is required.
rules.centralNeedsAirMeter: The central hopper requires vacuum or electric metering.
rules.sectionNeedsAdvancedMonitor: Row-by-row shutoff requires the advanced monitor.
rules.pneumaticDownforceTiers: Pneumatic downforce is available on the Large and Wide models.
rules.rowsRange: The number of rows was adjusted to the model's range.

custom.customPaintNote: Colors outside the brand palette add a custom paint charge.
custom.logoHint: PNG or SVG. Applied as a decal on the hoppers and frame.
custom.logoError: We couldn't read that file. Try a PNG or SVG under 2 MB.
custom.logoNotShared: The logo is not included in the shared link.

price.label: Indicative price
price.legendExport: Indicative FOB price, excluding taxes. Subject to manufacturer confirmation.
price.legendLocal: Indicative ex-works price in USD, excluding VAT. Subject to manufacturer confirmation.

transport.title: Road transport
transport.yellow: Above general limits: travels as special agricultural machinery (warning lights, time restrictions and permits).
transport.red: Above reference limits: requires a special permit and escort, or a different transport system.
transport.disclaimer: Demo reference limits. The manufacturer must confirm them against current regulations in the destination country.

coulter.title: Residue coulter
coulter.body: Cuts residue ahead of the discs, so the furrow stays clean and seed doesn't get mixed with straw.

discs.title: Offset double-disc opener
discs.body: Opens an even V-furrow, even in heavy residue, and places seed at the right depth.

gauge.title: Gauge wheels
gauge.body: Follow the ground on both sides of the furrow, so depth stays the same over hills and hollows.

meter.title: Seed meter
meter.body: Places every seed at the set spacing. With electric drive it enables row-by-row shutoff and variable rate.

closing.title: Closing wheels
closing.body: Close the furrow and ensure good seed-to-soil contact for even emergence.

hoppers.title: Hoppers
hoppers.body: More capacity means fewer refill stops and more acres per day.

transport.title: Transport system
transport.body: From field to road in minutes, without tools, from the tractor cab.

monitor.title: Planter monitor
monitor.body: Alerts you instantly if a row fails or plugs. See the real population in every row.

sim.title: Planting
sim.tryIt: Turn on row-by-row shutoff to see the savings

compare.title: Compare configurations
compare.empty: Save the current configuration as A or B to compare them.

quote.title: Request a quote
quote.intro: We'll reply with a formal quote and delivery terms to your country.
quote.name: Full name
quote.privacy: We only use this information to answer your request.
